hooks.name: kopt-session-start
hooks.description: kopt: one-line index status + navigation hint (<= 250 chars); starts a background incremental index refresh.

hooks.name: kopt-prompt-pointers
hooks.description: kopt: adds up to 4 symbol pointers (budgets.frontload tokens, 400 ms cap) only when the prompt names code that the index finds, or its domain words are clearly covered; silent on follow-ups. Re-arms the tool-call budget once it was reached.

hooks.name: kopt-governor
hooks.description: kopt session governor. No matcher on purpose: one process counts every call and gates by tool name. Blocks (exit 2, once per file/command, retry allowed): whole-file reads of files above governor.bigFileTokens, test/build commands with predictably long output (-> kopt_run; never watch/serve/run commands; at most 3 per session), identical test/build re-runs with nothing changed since (workspace state), and the session tool-call budget. The allow path prints nothing. Tool names verified 2026-10 (kiro.dev docs, Kiro IDE 0.12.318 bundle, kiro-cli 2.28 binary): read = read_file, read_files, fs_read (operations[]), read; shell = execute_bash, execute_pwsh, execute_cmd, shell; write = fs_write, fs_append, str_replace, edit_code, delete_file, write, code; MCP = mcp_<server>_<tool> (IDE) or @server/tool (CLI).

hooks.name: kopt-tool-telemetry
hooks.description: kopt: records the size of every tool response (where context tokens go); write tools also mark the workspace dirty. No output.

hooks.name: kopt-dirty-save
hooks.description: kopt: records agent file writes (unblocks re-runs, feeds the incremental index refresh).

hooks.name: kopt-stop
hooks.description: kopt: records the end of the turn in the local usage log (kopt stats) and drops log days older than 90 days; returns immediately and always exits 0 (never continues the agent).
